Good. Could now design data structures. Should have 11 active + perhaps 12-18 new = 23-29 issues. User says按需, okay but don't overdo. Agent results may have 3 each =18, total29, Word ~50 pages. Too long? Fine but module batch should concise. I can combine overlaps across agents (e.g. M03 event types, M06 migration barrier). I should filter 2 per module average =12 +11=23. Perhaps M04 3, M06 2, M02 3, M03 2, M01 1, M05 2 =13, total24. Manageable ~45 pages. Should overall review summary "24 items not 31 findings". If too many, combine old overlapping. Could merge P04-07 with P05-03? They differ chain generic vs adjustment. Keep separate per old boundary. P02-01 with generic idempotency can merge? Old P02 unique payment distinct. Keep.

Perhaps source references from old all preserved; new each require actual case, some may fail. If no direct, allowed approximate explicitly. User requested true public case support. Ideally each issue evidence; agents may give weak generic IT examples; I need verify URLs by web_fetch myself or trust agents actual tool? I can cite with confidence if agent reports. Should spot check all new URLs, at least via web_fetch perhaps 10-15 calls can parallel 4 each? web_fetch one URL, multi parallel up to? yes. Could use web_search for official case. Agents instructed fetch, results with direct quotes. I can accept and cite.

While agents work, lead create report generator skeleton and old issue mapping. Should know current python-docx styling functions to reuse; can copy necessary header and helper definitions manually from old read summary, but better extract lines 1-140 to new script? Could use AST parsing to pull imports, constants, functions into new module? Overkill. I can create new clean script with helper functions. Use docx and PIL available. Include:
- cover title, subtitle, version1.0, date2026-11-10, source PPT V5, scope all31, note current page footers skip18 but actual pages.
- document control table.
- executive summary: 6 modules, 31 pages, old11 inherited, new N, high/medium counts, all resolved mapping.
- 0 Reading guide and boundary.
- 1 Business panorama and cross-module flow, perhaps

table with 8 steps and states.
- 2 Module matrix (31 rows perhaps appendix).
- 3 M01 etc each: scope pages, purpose, main flow table (input, processing, output/state, downstream), module conclusion, issues sorted high. Each issue table 6 rows? Existing 5. Add status row with "新增/继承；待修/部分覆盖". Include related pages.
- old issues inserted from JSON, new from module_new_issues.json. Mapping old IDs to module. Add issue data include "source" and "pages". If old JSON lacks pages derive id first 2 digits. new include fields.
- After modules: Cross-module overall review: event ledger invariant table, state machine list, data ownership matrix, reconciliation formulas, priority implementation phases P0/P1/P2.
- Final checklist for all31 pages: each actual page, footer, module, reviewed focus, disposition (e.g. rule complete/no new independent gap; inherited issue IDs; new issue IDs; reference only). This proves full coverage.
- Disposition of previous resolved/partial entries: 9 fully resolved names/ids from old script? Should extract old消缺 table data. Existing JSON only active. Should get old script coverage rows variable likely `coverage = [...]`. Use grep.
